summary: Kitchen is clean and orderly with minimal visible hazards, mainly potential burn or slip risks.

hazards.title: Heavy pot near island edge
hazards.detail: Large Dutch oven sitting on a cloth near the island edge could slide or be knocked over.
fixSteps: Push cookware toward the center of the kitchen island.
Ensure pot sits on a stable, non-skid trivet.

hazards.title: Glassware on upper open shelf
hazards.detail: Stemware stacked closely in glass cabinet could fall if jostled or cabinets open.
fixSteps: Space out stemware to avoid tipping during access.
Add non-slip shelf liners inside upper cabinetry.

products.name: Silicone Trivet Mat
products.reason: Provides grip and prevents hot cookware from sliding on countertops.

products.name: Non-Slip Shelf Liner
products.reason: Keeps glassware securely upright inside cabinets.
